title: Prefer specific XCTest matchers.
summary: Its name is XCTest Specific Matcher. It is in the idiomatic kind of rules. It is an opt-in rule, so SwiftLint runs it only when the configuration enables it.

title: An XCTFail call should include a description of the assertion.
